notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist and Ardent Elementalist, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Agadeem's Awakening by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}, returning Ardent Elementalist and Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Ardent Elementalist and Dockside Extortionist enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Agadeem's Awakening from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
